mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Defender 110 P300 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A rebuilt 204PT engine for the Land Rover Defender 110 P300 typically costs £4,200-£6,500 supply-only through our specialist network, while reconditioned units start around £3,000 and used engines from £1,500. Supply and fit packages add labour on top, but remain significantly cheaper than main dealer pricing.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of a failing 204PT engine in a Land Rover Defender 110 P300?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common early warnings in the Land Rover Defender 110 P300 are unexplained coolant loss, a sweet smell from the engine bay, or a rattling noise on cold starts pointing to timing chain wear. You should also watch for illuminated temperature warning lights or white exhaust smoke.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Defender 110 P300?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A typical Land Rover Defender 110 P300 holds a UK market value of £35,000-£55,000, making a £4,200-£6,500 rebuilt engine a financially sound investment that preserves the vehicle's performance, reliability and strong resale value for years to come.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Defender 110 P300 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A professional supply and fit service for a Land Rover Defender 110 P300 typically takes 2-4 days depending on specialist workload and whether ancillary components such as the cooling system are being upgraded at the same time. Sourcing a quality rebuilt 204PT unit may add a few days.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between the Land Rover Defender 110 P300 and the P400 engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Land Rover Defender 110 P300 uses a 2.0-litre turbocharged inline-4 petrol engine (204PT) producing 300 PS, while the P400 uses a 3.0-litre inline-6 mild-hybrid petrol (306PS) producing 400 PS. The P300 is lighter and more affordable to maintain; the P400 offers greater torque and refinement.

historyTimeline.h2: Land Rover Defender 110 P300 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the all-new L663 Land Rover Defender 110 launched in 2020, the P300 badge marked the entry-level petrol option - a 2.0-litre turbocharged Ingenium four-cylinder delivering 300 PS to the long-wheelbase 4x4.

milestones.description: Introduction of the 204PT / AJ200P 2.0L turbocharged inline-4 petrol engine (300 PS / 296 hp, 400 Nm) in the L663 Defender 110 P300, paired with an 8-speed ZF automatic and permanent four-wheel drive.
2023 - Minor engine management software updates to improve throttle response and cold-start emissions; no mechanical changes to the 204PT unit.
present - Continued production alongside the P400 inline-six and P525 V8 petrol options; the Land Rover Defender 110 P300 remains the most affordable petrol variant in the range.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Land Rover Defender 110 P300 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

commonProblems.h2: Land Rover Defender 110 P300 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The 2.0-litre Ingenium petrol (204PT) in the Land Rover Defender 110 P300 is generally more reliable than its diesel Ingenium siblings, but cooling system wear and occasional timing chain stretch remain the dominant replacement drivers. Rebuilt Land Rover Defender 110 P300 engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Water Pump & Cooling System Failure - Why the Land Rover Defender 110 P300 204PT Overheats
problems.rootCause: The plastic-composite water pump housing and thermostat assembly degrade under sustained thermal cycling, leading to coolant seepage that can escalate to overheating if undetected.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace water pump, thermostat housing and coolant hoses with upgraded components.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly effective if caught before overheating damage; restores cooling integrity for 60k+ miles.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply and fit of a rebuilt 204PT with upgraded cooling components, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the engine has already suffered thermal damage such as a warped cylinder head.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Land Rover Defender 110 P300 of relevant age (2020-present) currently holds a UK market value of approximately £35,000-£55,000 [THIRD-PARTY - Auto Trader / Cazoo market observations]. At this value band, a reconditioned or rebuilt engine replacement is a small fraction of the vehicle's worth and easily justifies the investment to preserve performance and resale value.
problems.recommendation: If your Land Rover Defender 110 P300 is showing minor coolant loss but has not overheated, a preventative water pump and thermostat refresh by a JLR specialist is the most cost-effective route and can extend the engine's life significantly. Only pursue full replacement if thermal damage has already occurred.
problems.cta: -> Compare rebuilt 204PT Land Rover Defender 110 P300 engine prices

problems.h4: Timing Chain Stretch - Why the Land Rover Defender 110 P300 204PT Develops a Cold-Start Rattle
problems.rootCause: Over time the timing chain tensioner can lose hydraulic pressure, allowing the chain to stretch and produce a characteristic rattle on cold starts. While less common on the petrol Ingenium than the diesel, it is a documented pattern at higher mileages.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Strip front covers, replace chain, guides and updated tensioner assembly.
repairOptions.longevity: The definitive fix for chain rattle; prevents catastrophic valve-to-piston contact if addressed promptly.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply and fit of a rebuilt 204PT with upgraded valvetrain components, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Recommended only if chain failure has already caused internal engine damage.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: As above, the £35,000-£55,000 value of a Land Rover Defender 110 P300 makes a timing chain refresh a straightforward investment. Full replacement is rarely justified for chain rattle alone unless secondary damage has occurred.
problems.recommendation: Do not ignore a cold-start rattle in your Land Rover Defender 110 P300. A timely chain and tensioner replacement by a specialist is a well-documented fix that preserves the engine's longevity at a fraction of the cost of a full rebuild.
